summary: No. 21 Notre Dame beat No. 10 USC 48-20 at Notre Dame Stadium in Week 7 of the 2023 college football season. Safety Xavier Watts led the way with two interceptions, a forced fumble and a fumble return for a touchdown, and Notre Dame forced five turnovers and sacked Caleb Williams six times. The note includes a quarter-by-quarter live log of scoring plays and viewing details.
one_line: No. 21 Notre Dame routed No. 10 USC 48-20 behind five turnovers, six sacks and a big game from safety Xavier Watts.
key_facts: No. 21 Notre Dame beat No. 10 USC 48-20 at home in Week 7 on Saturday, Oct. 14, 2023, at Notre Dame Stadium in South Bend, Ind.
Notre Dame safety Xavier Watts intercepted Caleb Williams twice, forced a fumble and returned another fumble for a touchdown.
Williams finished 23-for-37 with 199 passing yards, one passing touchdown and three interceptions; it was the first time he had thrown three picks in one game in his career.
Notre Dame's defensive line recorded six sacks of Williams and three more quarterback hits.
Notre Dame won the turnover margin 5-0 and started drives on average at its own 47, while USC averaged its own 28.
USC outgained Notre Dame 302 to 251 in total yards; Notre Dame was 3-for-10 on third down and USC was 6-of-13.
Notre Dame led by quarter scores of 7, 17, 7 and 17 points against USC's 3, 3, 7 and 7.
Audric Estime scored two rushing touchdowns for Notre Dame; Jadarian Price added a 99-yard touchdown run in the fourth quarter.
Lincoln Riley pulled USC's starters after Watts' fumble-return touchdown made it 48-20; Miller Moss replaced Williams.
Quinten Joyner fumbled on USC's final drive, forced by Watts and recovered by Javontae Jean-Baptiste at the USC 36.
Notre Dame coach Marcus Freeman said he told his players to 'just compete against' Williams and credited the five turnovers.
The game aired on NBC with streaming on Peacock and Fubo, starting at 7:30 p.m. ET.
